card.name: Linking words before patient conditions
card.fires_on: The word 'patients' or 'with' right before a named condition in warnings (e.g. 'patients with diabetes'), plus the comma after 'hypertension' and the start of 'inter-' words.

modes.label: Patients / with
modes.description: The word 'patients' or 'with' just before a named disease or impairment in a warning.
modes.example: 5.5 Patients<< with>> Hepatic Impairment Patients with hep

modes.label: Comma after hypertension
modes.description: A comma after 'hypertension' that leads into 'either of which may contribute'.
modes.example: worsening of preexisting hypertension<<,>> either of which may contribute to the increased

modes.label: Start of inter- words
modes.description: The opening 'inter' of words like interstitial or intercurrent.

card.plain: It fires on small words that lead into a list of patient conditions such as kidney, liver or heart disease.
